title: Pace Bar
blurb: Codex and Claude quotas, local inference, and OpenRouter credit in one quiet macOS menu bar.
overview: A focused fork of CodexBar by Peter Steinberger and contributors, built with SwiftUI and AppKit. The Apple Silicon download is signed and notarized and requires macOS 14 or later; Intel Macs build from source. Forecasts are estimates, not an account switcher.
features: One quota ring per Codex and Claude subscription
Pooled Codex forecast that flags quota about to reset unused
Local inference token counts and speed, with optional GPU readings
OpenRouter balance kept distinct from estimated API cost

title: Herdwick
blurb: A native iPhone and iPad client for herdr: read and answer your coding agents over SSH.
overview: Herdwick connects to your own machine over SSH, shows every agent herdr tracks, and renders their transcripts as conversations, with a live terminal when you need it. Requires iOS 26 and a Mac or Linux host running herdr; build from source with Xcode. An independent project, not affiliated with herdr or Tailscale.
features: Inbox of agents across hosts, with the ones that need you first
omp, Claude Code and Codex transcripts rendered as chat
Native controls for questions and permission prompts
Plain SSH or an embedded Tailscale node; no account or analytics

title: Dictation
blurb: Mac-first technical dictation with local speech recognition and custom vocabulary, built on Handy.

media.title: preview
media.alt: The Dynamic Orb recording overlay: a dark glass capsule appears, a rainbow light ripples as you speak, a cursor pulls a drop from its edge that melts back, and the light swirls while transcribing.
media.caption: Dynamic Orb overlay · light ripples as you speak and swirls while transcribing.

overview: An independent Handy-based app with Fast and Accurate speech-recognition presets. Plain dictation works offline after model downloads; optional text cleanup sends the transcript to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you configure. The Apple Silicon download is signed and notarized.
features: Local speech recognition with two presets
Custom vocabulary for the Accurate preset
Optional transcript cleanup with a plain-text fallback

title: StreamApp
blurb: Record your screen or stream to Twitch from your Mac’s menu bar.
overview: A menu bar app for screen or window capture, webcam and audio controls, Twitch streaming, a notch teleprompter, and desktop annotation. The download is signed and notarized for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 26 or newer; source builds need no signing certificate. GPL-3.0.
features: Desktop and Full Camera layouts with webcam punch-in
Twitch streaming with explicit start confirmation
Desktop drawing and live loudness meters

title: Tablet Companion
blurb: Set up a Wacom tablet and its drawing shortcuts on your Mac.
overview: A setup companion for the Wacom Intuos BT S, tested with driver 6.4.14-1. It hands off the Wacom driver installer and assigns tablet-button shortcuts for StreamApp drawing while preserving other buttons. Other tablets are not supported yet. The download is signed and notarized for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 26 or newer.
features: Guided Wacom driver download and installer handoff

title: CenterSeat
blurb: A movie-seat ranking project that compares seats together across showtimes.
overview: CenterSeat compares seats across nearby showtimes and ranks contiguous seats. Live searches require a configured data provider.
features: Code and setup are available on GitHub
Live searches require a configured provider

title: Boilerplate
blurb: My macOS and Linux workspace setup, managed with chezmoi and mise.
overview: Boilerplate is a cross-platform workspace setup managed with chezmoi and mise. The repository includes setup notes for macOS and Linux.

title: Jeopardy study platform
blurb: A Jeopardy study platform with search and practice tools.
overview: This study platform brings search, practice modes, full boards, answer validation, and progress tracking into one place.

title: OpenCode Monitor
blurb: A small macOS menu bar app for keeping an OpenCode server under control.
overview: OpenCode Monitor keeps server status, start and stop controls, logs, updates, and optional idle shutdown in a macOS menu bar app.

title: AudioReader
blurb: A local audiobook player with synchronized transcription captions.
overview: AudioReader serves local audio in a browser and pairs playback with VTT captions generated from transcription.

title: Farkle Scorer
blurb: An offline iOS Farkle scorer with tap-to-score dice and nearby multiplayer experiments.
overview: Farkle Scorer handles visual dice selection, manual entry for physical dice, house rules, and optional nearby multiplayer exploration.

title: Flipping Seven Calculator
blurb: An iOS scorekeeper for Flip 7 with round history and undo.
overview: Flipping Seven Calculator keeps score on iPhone and iPad with card taps, bonuses, round history, undo, and local persistence.

title: Spotify DJ
blurb: An earlier experiment in ordering playlists by BPM, key, and danceability.
overview: Spotify DJ analyzes playlist audio features and suggests an order based on BPM, key, danceability, and energy. Check the repository setup before running it.

title: Physical computing final
blurb: A college physical-computing project built around a garden owl.
overview: This college physical-computing project explored a garden owl with camera, light, and sound sensors, alongside a documented data flow.

title: ComicScanner
blurb: An earlier comic-cataloging project with image matching and barcode scanning.
overview: ComicScanner is the earlier version of a comic-catalog idea, with barcode scanning, metadata lookup, image matching, and collection management.

title: RSS News Summarizer
blurb: An RSS reader experiment that summarizes feeds in a small web interface.
overview: RSS News Summarizer reads feeds, aggregates sources, and writes short summaries in a web interface.

title: Spotify Preference Analyst
blurb: A music-analysis project that maps listening preferences with audio features and distance math.
overview: Spotify Preference Analyst explores listening patterns with audio features, Euclidean distance, and visualizations.
